contract.provides: Accepted at the existing completed internal-review scope: N(gamma_G(rho_A,rho_B)) >= G*N(rho_A)+(G-1)*(N(rho_B)+1) for every such independent finite-energy pair, every finite n>=1 and finite G>1. Independent product thermal inputs attain equality. Equality uniqueness is not claimed.
contract.requires: For every finite integer n>=1, two n-mode finite-energy input groups rho_A and rho_B form the product rho_A tensor rho_B. Arbitrary correlations and entanglement WITHIN either input group are allowed. Finite energy means finite mean total photon number in each group. The quantum-limited phase-insensitive amplifier has any fixed finite gain G>1 and retained annihilators c_j=sqrt(G)*a_j+sqrt(G-1)*b_j^dagger. Natural-log von Neumann entropy is measured in nats; N(rho)=g^(-1)(S(rho)/n), g(r)=(r+1)ln(r+1)-r ln r. This is a mathematical state/channel specification, not an acquired preparation, entropy oracle or experimental interface.
